verdict.rationale: LegalOS publishes its own preparation time: attorney-reviewed filings "in as little as 48 hours" and filing readiness in 48–72 hours. Government processing times are barely covered. The only sign is an H-1B blog post that says it walks through "timeline", and the fee calculator mentions Premium Processing only as a fee, not a duration. missing for 10: published USCIS/government processing times per visa type, end-to-end timeline breakdown per category, independent corroboration of the 48–72 hour preparation claim.
